title: Academic Writer library route (.academic-helper/library.json)
description: Which library answers book lookups for one article project. A missing file means Trove only.

route.description: trove, pageindex, or both (one answers, the other is timed quietly on the same request).

primary.description: Which library answers when route is both. Defaults to trove. With a single route it must match that route.

command.description: How to run the PageIndex library command, as one string or a list of words (no shell). The AW_PAGEINDEX_COMMAND setting wins over this; the default is pilib.

shelf.description: Path to the shelf file (books this article may use, plus an optional map from Trove ids to PageIndex books). Relative paths start at the project folder.

enabled.description: Turn the quiet second lookup off without changing the route. Default true when route is both.
